## Phase 1 RCA — confirmed before repair

**Proven mechanism.** `tests/integration/rebar_reconciler/test_reconcile_roundtrip.py::_load_module` unconditionally constructs a fresh module and assigns it to `sys.modules[name]` (lines 45-52). Its module-scoped `adf` fixture invokes that helper with the canonical key `rebar_reconciler.adapters.jira.adf` (lines 77-81). During unit collection, `test_applier_assignee_soft_fail.py` has already seeded canonical ADF object A; `AdfCodec` binds A in `rich_text_codec.py:19`. The integration fixture then replaces the canonical key with distinct object B. The later cutover test resolves and monkeypatches B, while `AdfCodec.to_wire` still calls A at `rich_text_codec.py:62-66`; therefore B degrades to plain ADF but A still sees marklas and renders rich ADF.

**Deterministic minimal reproduction (RED).**
`pytest -q tests/integration/rebar_reconciler/test_reconcile_roundtrip.py::test_description_survives_outbound_adf_inbound_unchanged tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/apply/test_applier_assignee_soft_fail.py::test_assignee_not_found_alone_does_not_raise tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_rich_text_cutover.py::test_cloud_functions_degrade_without_marklas`
=> `1 failed, 2 passed`; exact reported rich-heading/list versus plain-paragraph assertion. Target alone, the reconciler unit tier alone (2771 passed), and immediate rich-text neighbors are green. Current `origin/main` reproduces, falsifying causation by the subprocess-environment worktree.

**Runtime proof.** Collection/runtime instrumentation measured codec A and canonical B as identical before the integration test, then distinct immediately after its ADF fixture executed. A four-cell identity experiment showed codec output follows A exclusively: A=None/B=None -> plain; A=real/B=None -> rich mismatch; A=None/B=real -> plain. Thus hidden marklas cache/state is rejected. A direct intervention restoring `sys.modules[canonical]` to codec A immediately before the unchanged target made the same three-node order green (`3 passed`).

**History/prior evidence.** `f72a8d7c3f` moved this fixture to the canonical dotted key. `7e3c50242d` changed its loader from `setdefault` to unconditional replacement. Closed bug `unrelative-inbred-piglet` / 2bc7 previously proved the same shared-key/two-live-module order-dependence class; its audit explicitly named `adf` among shared keys and recorded that most by-path loaders remained unguarded.

**Legitimacy.** Confirmed defect: `rich_text_codec.py:3-7` defines `AdfCodec` as a pass-through to the pinned ADF module, and `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/conftest.py:58-61` explicitly requires canonical dotted keys/package attributes to preserve the same module identity. The integration test fixture violates that test-infrastructure invariant.

**Caller-dependency gate.** Expected post-fix behavior: requesting the same `(canonical name, source path)` returns the already-registered module rather than replacing it. `_load_module` has four local callers: the canonical ADF fixture, `outbound_differ`, `inbound_differ`, and the unique `_4af8_roundtrip_outbound_fields` key. All consume module functions and none asserts or relies on a fresh object; usage is incidental. A different source path under the same name must still replace, preserving intentional isolation. No behavioral dependency blocks repair.
